questions.stemHtml: A 45-year-old woman presented to the ER with dizziness. Her blood pressure is 80/60 mmHg, pulse rate is 45/minute. She was subsequently put in the below position. What was the reason for using this position?

options.label: A
options.text: She was conscious and pulse present

options.label: B
options.text: She was unconscious and pulse present

options.label: C
options.text: She was conscious and no pulse
